        shift_y, shift_x = (
            (1, 0),
            (-1, 0),
            (0, 1),
            (0, -1),
        )[(step // 2) % 4]
        padded = F.pad(images, (1, 1, 1, 1), mode="replicate")
        images = padded[
            :,
            :,
            1 - shift_y : 29 - shift_y,
